scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && (npm run dev:api & npm run dev:web)
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@caradvocate/api && npm run build --workspace=@caradvocate/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run typecheck:scripts
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck && npm run test:api && npm run test:e2e
